label: ercot63 gas bridge
definition: KEEPER (CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS; owner promotion approved 2026-07-13, supersedes ercot59-storage-deploy). Promoted ercot59-storage-deploy recipe + ONE structural delta, ercot_gas_commitment_bridge — the P1-native gas-CC committed-state bridge (CC-only scope, measured committed-CC LSL/HSL cap-weighted p50 min-load 0.574, economic leg on the startup-restart inequality bounded to one DA operating day, no startup-aware screen — adjudications recorded at the ScenarioConfig field and in the 2026-07-12 ERCOT-63 calibration-log entry); ercot_offer_surface_lowcurve stays OFF (the 2023 probe ladder showed the composition re-instates the markdown's spread-compression signature, diagnosis §5, while the bridge alone moves every storage/spread circle target the right way). On the full 2023-2025 bundle: C1/C2/C3a/C3b/C4/C5a/C7/C8 PASS, C5c-2024 storage-shape flips the keeper's own ledgered FAIL (r=0.329) to PASS, and the sole ledgered caveat is C3c-2024 price-tail/scarcity — inherited byte-identical from ercot59 (27h; the bridge floors overnight/midday idle gaps, not the scarcity tail).
market_story: The bridge holds P0-committed merchant gas-CC at min-load across sub-DA-day idle gaps (overnight between run-days — the 902 CC plant-nights/yr the keeper cycled off) because re-paying the published startup cost exceeds the net cost of holding at LSL: real ERCOT CCs stay synchronized overnight at their LSL block. That committed-state energy deepens the price troughs toward the measured $10-15 epochs, widens the daily spread from below, lets batteries cross the round-trip hurdle on more days (storage 0.65->0.74 TWh, HE18/19 discharge up), and returns the overnight energy the keeper served with coal to gas-CC — toward BOTH classes' measured actuals (CC_REGULAR onto 141.7 actual; coal -1.4 TWh toward its 60.4 actual). C5c-2024 monthly storage shape, the keeper's own ledgered FAIL, flips to PASS.
